situation: My mother-in-law said 'must be nice to order takeout every night' while visiting. It's a one-off dig and I don't want a thing.
reply: Ha, it's been a hectic month! Actually, would you show me your chicken soup next time you're over? Luca still talks about it.
note: Face value denies the dig any oxygen, and the question is genuine, not flattery.

situation: 室友在群里说“我就自己倒垃圾吧，反正也没人管”。确实最近几次都是她倒的。
reply: 听起来你是烦我最近没倒垃圾，这确实是我的问题。我现在就去倒。以后我们排个表，一人一周，你看行吗？
note: 她的不满有道理时，处理内容，不纠结语气。

situation: Since I got engaged, my best friend keeps making little digs ('some of us still pay rent alone'). I asked once and she said she's fine. It just happened again.
reply: I asked a while back and you said you were fine, and I took your word for it. The comments are still coming, so I'm not going to keep guessing. If something about the engagement is hard for you, I'd honestly rather hear it straight. Whenever you want to talk, I'm here, and until then I'll take things at face value.
note: Second time, name the pattern and hand her the choice. Then really do take messages at face value.

situation: 项目会上大家定了换新的物流供应商，会后同事小林在工作群里回了一句“行，你们定就好，反正我的意见也不重要”。她平时不这样说话，我也不确定她具体是对哪一点不满。
reply: 小林，可能是我想多了，不过看你刚才群里那句，是不是对换供应商这件事有不同看法？我是真心想听。明天上午你方便的话，我们单独聊十五分钟？
note: 不满明显和一件具体的事有关，但不知道是哪一点：私下温和地点出来问一句，不在群里接话，也不替她解读。

situation: My sister texted 'Don't worry, I'll host Thanksgiving AGAIN, it's fine, someone has to.' She's hosted three years running and I did say I'd take a turn. I'd rather not do this over text.
reply: That sounds like it's not fine, and fair enough: you've hosted three years in a row and I said I'd take a turn. Can I call you tonight after 8? I'd like to sort out this year properly, and I'm happy for it to be at mine.
note: The dig wraps a legitimate point, so own it and move to a call; over text this one turns into a fight.

situation: Freelance designer. Client Mark emailed 'As I've already said twice, the logo needs to be bigger. Not sure how else to put it.' I did make it bigger in v2 and he approved v2 on Friday. Now we're on v3.
reply: Hi Mark, understood, you'd like the logo bigger than it is in v3. So I get it right this round: should it fill about a third of the header width, or closer to half? I'll send the revised version by 3pm tomorrow, Wednesday.
note: Answer the request, not the tone, and turn a vague 'bigger' into a choice so there is no v4. Raise the v2 approval only if extra rounds become a billing question.

situation: I joined standup 5 minutes late this morning because a customer call ran over. Right after, my manager Colleen posted in the team channel: 'Friendly reminder that standup starts at 9:30, for those who forgot.' Obviously aimed at me. First time I've been late in months.
reply: Hi Colleen, that one was me, sorry for joining late this morning. A call with Brightwater ran over and I should have given you a heads-up. If it ever happens again, I'll message you before 9:30.
note: Reply privately, not in the channel. A small, fair complaint sits inside the dig, so own it in one line and deal with the contents; no comment on the tone.

situation: 我妈在家族群里发：“现在都是大忙人了，一个月也想不起来给妈打个电话。” 明显是说我，确实最近加班很少打电话。不想在群里接这个话。
reply: 妈，最近确实打得少了，是我不好。今晚八点我给您打视频，好好聊聊，让朵朵给您看看她新学的舞。
note: 私聊回，不在群里接；她的不满有道理，就认一句，再换成更亲近的方式联系，不解释加班。

situation: Rob in finance emailed me: 'Per my last email, I still need the Q3 vendor invoices. Not sure how else to ask.' I checked, and he did email me on Sept 21 and I missed it.
reply: Hi Rob, thanks for resending, I'd missed your email on the 21st, that's on me. All 14 Q3 vendor invoices are attached, plus the two credit notes from Halden. Let me know if anything's still missing.
note: Take it at face value: own the miss in half a sentence, give him what he needs, and leave the tone alone.

situation: We had friends over Saturday and it ran late. This morning there's a note on our door from the downstairs neighbour: 'Hope the party was fun! Some of us have to work in the morning :)' I've never met her properly. I want to reply without starting a feud.
reply: Hi, it's Dan from 3B. Got your note, and you're right, we ran late on Saturday. Sorry about that. Next time we have people over I'll let you know in advance and we'll wrap up by 11. If it's ever too loud, just knock or text me on 07700 900312.
note: The snark wraps a fair complaint, so answer the contents, own it once, and give her a direct channel so the next one isn't a note.

situation: I'm a team lead. At 3pm on Friday I asked my report Jamal to update the client deck for Monday at 10, because the client had just moved the meeting up. He replied in Slack: 'Sure, I'll just cancel my weekend then 🙂'. Honestly, it is a lot to drop on him.
reply: Sounds like that landed badly, and that's fair, it's a lot to drop on you at 3 on a Friday. Your weekend stays yours. Could you update just the pricing slide before you log off today? I'll do the rest myself first thing Monday.
note: When the snark wraps a legitimate grievance, name it, concede the fair part and change the ask; don't answer the tone.

situation: 下周我要去成都出差四天，跟老婆说了以后，她回了一句：“去吧去吧，反正家里两个孩子我一个人弄惯了。”这个月我确实已经出差三次了。
reply: 听起来你是真累了。这个月我出差三次，家里的事都压在你一个人身上，这不公平。回来那个周末两个孩子我全包，你好好歇两天。今晚孩子睡了我们聊聊，看以后出差怎么安排，才不会总是你一个人扛，好吗？
note: 抱怨里有真实内容时，先接住内容，给一个具体补偿，再约时间谈根本的安排。

situation: My ex Greg and I co-parent. I asked to swap weekends because of a work trip and he texted 'Sure, I'll rearrange my life around your job again.' I asked if he was annoyed and he said 'I'm not annoyed.' The swap is Friday Oct 9 to Sunday Oct 11.
reply: Okay, thanks Greg, I appreciate it. I'll drop Maya and Theo at yours on Friday 9 October at 5:30 with their school bags, and pick them up Sunday at 6. If you'd like a weekend back, I can take the 23rd to the 25th.
note: He denied it, so take him at his word once and stick to logistics; name the pattern only if the digs keep coming.

situation: Six of us have a friends' group chat. I posted photos from a hiking weekend and Chris replied 'Nice to see some people have time for trips but not for Dave's birthday 🙃'. I did miss Dave's birthday last week, because I had flu.
reply: Ha, fair, I was gutted to miss it. Flu had me flat on the sofa all weekend. Dave, first round's on me next time we're out, you pick the night.
note: In a group chat, answer briefly at face value and move on; if Dave himself seems hurt, message him privately rather than in the group.

situation: I posted on LinkedIn that I've been promoted to engineering manager. A former teammate, Greg, who applied for the same role before he left, commented publicly: 'Congrats! Funny how things work out for people who are in the right meetings 😉'.
reply: Thanks, Greg! Plenty more meetings in my future, that's for sure. Hope things are going well at Oakline.
note: A public dig gets a brief face-value reply in public; no defence of how you got the job, and no private post-mortem.

situation: I own a small café. A customer left a public 3-star review on our listing: 'Lovely place, if you have 40 minutes to spare for a flat white :)'. Saturday really was chaos because one of our two baristas called in sick.
reply:
Thanks for coming in, and for the kind words about the place. You're right, Saturday's wait was far too long; we were a barista down that morning. If you give us another try, mention this review at the till and your flat white is on us.
Ana, owner
note: A public review gets a public face-value reply: own the fair part in one line, no defensiveness, and one small make-good other readers can see.

situation: 我在上海工作，爸在老家住，这半年他去医院复查了四次，都是我哥请假陪的。刚才我私聊问爸的情况，我哥回：“你在上海过得挺好吧，爸这边反正有我，你放心。”我想以后复查跟他轮流陪，国庆1号到5号我回家，这几天爸的事可以都交给我。
reply: 哥，这半年爸四次复查都是你请假陪的，你一个人扛着，肯定很累。今晚我给你打个电话好不好？想跟你商量一下，以后复查咱俩轮流陪。国庆1号到5号我在家，这几天爸的事交给我，你也歇一歇。
note: 话里带刺，但怨气是真的：不接刺，直接回应背后的分工问题，并换成电话谈。

situation: La profesora de mi hija Lucía, la señora Ortega, escribió en el grupo de WhatsApp de padres: 'Recuerdo que los deberes no son opcionales, aunque algunas familias parecen pensar lo contrario.' Lucía no ha entregado dos fichas de matemáticas este mes porque estuvo una semana con gripe, y las terminará este fin de semana. Soy Marta y no quiero contestar en el grupo.
reply: Hola, señora Ortega, soy Marta, la madre de Lucía. Le escribo por las dos fichas de matemáticas que Lucía no ha entregado este mes: estuvo una semana con gripe y se le quedaron atrás. Las termina este fin de semana y se las lleva el lunes 5 de octubre. A partir de ahora, si falta por enfermedad, se lo digo por aquí ese mismo día.
note: Se contesta en privado y al contenido, no a la indirecta del grupo; no se discute el tono con la profesora.

situation: I'm planning dinner for my three-month anniversary with my girlfriend Sam on Saturday. I said no to her first two restaurant ideas because they're both over an hour's drive, and she texted back: 'Fine. Whatever you want, it's your call apparently.' Honestly, I'd do the drive if it matters to her.
reply: That sounds like not-fine, and fair enough, I shot down both of your picks. It was only the hour's drive, not the places themselves. What would you actually like for Saturday? If one of those two is the one, I'm happy to do the drive.
note: Name it gently and own your part; it's a real disagreement in a snippy wrapper.

situation: Ich bin nach sechs Monaten Elternzeit zurück im Büro. Mein Kollege Stefan, der in der Zeit das Kundenprojekt Weber übernommen hat, schrieb mir heute im Team-Chat: 'Na, auch mal wieder da? Muss schön sein, ein halbes Jahr frei.' Es ist das erste Mal, und ich will mich weder rechtfertigen noch streiten.
reply: Ja, schön, wieder da zu sein! Danke, dass du in der Zeit das Projekt Weber übernommen hast. Hast du diese Woche 20 Minuten, um mich auf den neuesten Stand zu bringen? Der Kaffee geht auf mich.
note: Einmaliger Seitenhieb: wörtlich nehmen und nicht erklären, dass Elternzeit kein Urlaub ist. Kommt so etwas wieder, das Muster freundlich unter vier Augen ansprechen.

situation: I'm an ops lead and I post process updates in our team Slack. My peer Dana has replied to the last three with things like 'Great, another process change 🙄' and 'Love finding out about this in the channel'. I didn't run any of those changes past her team first. I want to message her privately.
reply: Hi Dana, I might be reading tone into this, but your replies to my last few process updates sound frustrated, and I'd rather ask than guess. I also realise I didn't run any of those changes past your team before posting them. Is that the part that's bothering you, or is it the changes themselves? Either way I'd honestly like to hear it, and I'm happy to grab 15 minutes this week.
note: A repeated dig with a real grievance inside: name it privately, own the fair part, and ask.

situation: 周六上午10点，部门领导张总在工作群里问月报什么时候能交，我在陪女儿参加钢琴比赛，没看到。下午他又在群里说：“有些同事周末消息都不回啊，看来工作不太着急。”月报我周一上午10点前能交。不想在群里解释。
reply: 张总，周六上午的消息我下午才看到，回晚了。月报周一上午10点前发给您。
note: 私聊回，只回内容：什么时候看到、什么时候交，不解释周末在做什么，也不在群里接这句话；如果周末必须秒回成了常态，再约一对一谈预期。

situation: I promised my daughter Maya, 16, I'd be at her volleyball final on Tuesday, and I missed it because a work meeting ran over. Tonight she texted 'Don't worry, I know work comes first 🙂'. She's in her room upstairs, and honestly she's right to be upset.
reply: That's fair, Maya, and I'm sorry. I promised I'd be at your final and I let a meeting come first, which isn't how I want it to be. Can I come up and say this properly, and hear how the match went?
note: The dig wraps a real grievance: deal with the contents, don't defend the meeting, and move to face to face.

situation: For my 30th last Saturday I had a tiny dinner at home for six: mostly family plus my two oldest friends. My friend Bella, who I see at our monthly book club, saw the photos and texted 'Looks like a lovely party, guess my invite got lost in the post 🙃'. Book club is next Thursday, and I'd genuinely like to have a birthday drink with her.
reply: It was a really lovely evening, thank you! It was just a tiny dinner at home for six, mostly family, so no invites went out beyond that. I'd love to celebrate with you too, though: fancy a birthday drink before book club on Thursday the 8th?
note: Take it at face value with the honest reason in one line; no long defence of the guest list, and a real invite so the dig has nowhere to go.
